sections.section_title: OPAMP output redirection to an internal COMP channel
sections.text_helper: Section 24.4.4 "OPAMP output redirection to an internal COMP channel" in chapter 24 (Operational amplifier (OPAMP)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 729.
sections.section_content:
The operational amplifier output OUT can be redirected internally to a COMP channel, by
setting the OPAINTOEN bit of the OPAMP_CSR register. In this case, the I/O pin
OPAMP_VOUT on which the operation amplifier output OUT is mapped can be used for
another purpose. See Table179 for possible COMP input channel assignment to OPAMP
instances.
When OUT is connected to a COMP input channel, it is not connected to the
OPAMP_VOUT pin.
